name: popsicle
headline: Butterfli social media curation app
short_description: Butterfli web and mobile application for social media marketing and content curation
author: bbwebservices

sections.overview:
Butterfli-app is a web and mobile application designed for social media marketing and content curation. Developed by bbwebservices, it provides tools to manage marketing activities across social platforms. The application supports both web and mobile access, enabling users to curate and distribute content effectively. It serves marketing professionals and teams looking to streamline their social media operations.
Curating and organizing content for multiple social media channels
Planning and scheduling social media marketing campaigns
Managing brand presence across web and mobile platforms
Coordinating team content distribution workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/bbwebservices/butterfli-app`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 7-day social media content calendar for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business, using the Butterfli app. Include a mix of promotional posts, engaging questions, and user-generated content. Focus on driving engagement and brand awareness. Use [HASHTAGS] and [HASHTAGS] to increase reach.
```
